questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. The number on left side of (-) is related to the number of the right side of (-) with some Logic/Rule/Relation. Three are similar on basis of same Logic/Rule/Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

1st Number – 2nd number = 23

Option (1) 167 – 144 → 167 – 144 = 23

Option (2) 132 – 109 → 132 – 109 = 23

Option (3) 182 – 159 → 182 - 159 = 23

Option (4) **144 – 120** → 144 – 120 = 24 ≠ 23

Hence, “144 – 120” is an odd one.

questions.question: L, M, N, O, and P are five cousins. L is twice as old as M. N is half the age of M. L is half the age of P and N is twice the age of O. Who is the youngest?
questions.solution:
**Given:** L, M, N, O, and P are five cousins. 

1) L is twice as old as M. 

L > M

2) N is half the age of M.

L > M > N

3) L is half the age of P and N is twice the age of O.

P > L > M > N > O

Thus, according to the final arrangement O is the youngest.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a row 55 people facing north, Raman is 10th to the right of Richa. If Richa is 23rd from the left end of a row, then what is the position of Raman from the right end of a row?
questions.solution:
Total number of people = 55

Raman's position from the right of Richa = 10th

Richa's position from the left end = 23rd

Raman's position from the left end = 23rd + 10th = 33rd

Raman's position from the right end = Total number of people - Raman's position from the left end + 1

= 55 - 33 + 1

= 23

Hence, **23rd** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

(15, 1, 7, 32) (20, 2, 7, 47) (13, 3, 7, 50) (7, 4, ?, 48)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**Fourth term - First term = Two digit number (digit 1 = second term & digit 2 = third term)**

We apply the pattern to the given series:

1) (15, 1, 7, 32)

 __**32 - 15**__ = 17 i.e. 1,7

2) (20, 2, 7, 47)

 __47____ - 20__ = 27 i.e. 2,7

3) (13, 3, 7, 50)

 __50 - 13__ = 37 i.e. 3,7

4) (7, 4, ?, 48)

 __48 - 7__ = 41 i.e. 4,1 

So, **? = 1**.

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**
